scope: TANF under s 43-17-5: the maximum for the dependent child's budget and the family cap (subs. (1)); denial (subs. (3)); work activity exemptions, hours and sanctions (subs. (6)(b), (c), (e)); school attendance and vaccination sanctions (subs. (4)(f), (5)); three duties with deadlines as regulative rules (subs. (3)(h), (5), (6)(b)). The actual payment (Department regulations, 1988 standard of need) is not deposited.
seat: the parent or caretaker relative applying for, or receiving, TANF
